summary: Preserve the engine-run reference consumed by binders and joined campaigns.
details: Both evidence producers now retain the resolved engine-run path alongside its raw and record hashes, allowing the existing consumer to validate and read that exact file.

The production reader still refuses missing files, changed raw or record hashes and incomplete engine-run records. Actual producer-expression controls cover both target scopes without creating successful native evidence.
Native campaigns, complete technical acceptance, sealing, promotion and publication remain pending.
